title.narrative: The Biodiversity Finance Initiative - Phase II (BIOFIN Uganda)

description.narrative: At country level, the programme is designed to contribute to sustainable natural resource management, ecosystem and community resilience to climate change and livelihoods improvement. At global level, it is aligned to the Sustainable Development Goals (SDGs) and UNDP strategic plan, BIOFIN results framework. At national level, the programme is aligned to Uganda’s Vision 2040, the National Biodiversity Strategic Plan (NBSAPII), the National Biodiversity Finance Plan (NBFP), and will contribute to achievement of the Third National Development Plan (NDPIII) objective of protecting, restoring, and maintaining the integrity of degraded fragile ecosystems and increasing the country’s resilience to the impacts of climate change through mobilizing adequate additional financial resources to meet the biodiversity funding gap as well as ensure that fund are used efficiently and effectively to address the biodiversity and ecosystem challenges in biodiversity and conservation and management. The focus for Phase II will be to develop a biodiversity index to inform ecological fiscal transfer mechanisms, support the initiation of Payment for Ecosystem Services (PES) programme to enhance the use of economic instruments as incentives for biodiversity conservation and management; and initiate the piloting ecotourism and eco-enterprises for wetlands and Ramsar sites in cities and municipalities in Uganda

condition.narrative: Social and environmental sustainability will be enhanced through application of the UNDP Social and Environmental Standards (http://www.undp.org/ses) and related Accountability Mechanism (http://www.undp.org/secu-srm).
